query: Crude oil prices rise 12% after OPEC supply cut announcement
event_summary: OPEC+ agreed to cut production by 1.2 million barrels per day, starting in November, causing crude oil prices to surge 12% in a single trading session.

ev-001.title: OPEC cuts supply by 1.2M barrels/day
ev-001.text: OPEC+ agreed to cut production by 1.2 million barrels per day, starting in November, citing market tightening and the need to support crude prices.

ev-002.title: Natural gas prices rise 8% in sympathy
ev-002.text: Natural gas futures climbed 8% on the same trading day as crude, driven by correlated demand expectations across energy commodities.

ev-003.title: Higher oil prices may increase inflation expectations
ev-003.text: Pricing pressure transmits through transportation, manufacturing and consumer goods. Historical data shows a 0.72 correlation between crude oil price spikes and 3-month CPI movements.

ev-004.title: Elevated inflation may prompt Fed to hold rates higher
ev-004.text: Policy makers cited elevated inflation sensitivity and continued data dependence. A sustained oil price increase historically precedes a shift in Fed forward guidance.

ev-005.title: Bank sector may face higher funding costs
ev-005.source: Reasoning: higher interest rates → margin pressure
ev-005.text: A tighter funding environment driven by elevated policy rates can affect net interest margins unevenly. Smaller regional banks are disproportionately exposed.

ev-006.title: Real estate demand softens with rising mortgage rates
ev-006.source: Reasoning: rate sensitivity of housing market
ev-006.text: Each 100bps increase in 30-year mortgage rates historically reduces home sales volume by 8–12% within 6 months. Rate-sensitive REITs face elevated cap rate compression.

ev-007.title: Higher discount rates compress growth stock valuations
ev-007.source: SEC Form 10-K Reference: XLK constituents, FY2024
ev-007.text: Duration-sensitive growth equities — particularly mega-cap tech — are disproportionately impacted by rising real yields as their future cash flows are discounted at a higher rate.

ev-008.title: Broad market indices decline on risk-off rotation
ev-008.text: When multiple large sectors (financials, real estate, tech) face simultaneous headwinds, the probability of a broad index pullback increases significantly. Historical analogues from 2018 and 2022 show -3% to -8% corrections in similar macro environments.
